# AI v2 design todo, part A (design to update)

# A.20 Docs and Idea assistant canvases (`DocsAi.dc.html`, `DocsAiCare.dc.html`, `IdeaAi.dc.html`)

Menus and panels are built (`ui/src/components/docs/ai/*`, `ideas/*`). The change: assistants **edit directly with Undo** (page versions), "suggest first" is an optional mode (default off), proposals are removed. Since KBM-24 (PR #318, commit `ac0f410d`, 2026-11-08) the proposals are gone from the server too (routes, columns, notification kind), the settings and page flags that only they used are dropped (migration `e6a8c0d2f4b6`), **Send to AI** is back in a new form (B-57, B-58) and the page shows a bar when an AI wrote its latest version (B-59). Checked against the code and the commit, not by running the app.
